evidence.claim: H1 2026 continuing revenue KRW 2.578tn, operating income KRW 1.167tn, operating cash flow KRW 1.392tn; issued shares at 2026-06-30 were 46.290951m.

Q2 2026 revenue KRW 1.321tn and operating profit KRW 0.586tn; 2026 revenue growth guidance +15% to +20% with management expecting the upper end. Cumulative CMO/CDO orders were 115/176 and cumulative order value USD 21.7bn.
Board approved a KRW 3tn rights offering on 2026-08-28: 2.27m new shares at KRW 1.322m indicative issue price; approximately KRW 2.706tn earmarked for PolyPeptide and KRW 0.295tn for Bio Campus II.
PolyPeptide tender offer is CHF 44.31/share, aggregate equity value about CHF 1.46bn; main offer period 2026-09-15 to 2026-10-12, minimum acceptance threshold 66 2/3%, with regulatory conditions.
PolyPeptide H1 2026 revenue EUR 236.6m (+41.6%), EBITDA EUR 49.1m (20.7% margin), EBIT EUR 22.0m and net income EUR 9.1m.
PolyPeptide H1 2026 operating cash flow EUR 25.2m, capex EUR 41.3m, disclosed FCF negative EUR 19.1m and net debt EUR 90.2m.

PolyPeptide H1 2026 metabolic therapeutics revenue grew 72.7% and reached 68.4% of revenue; concentration to metabolic demand is therefore strategically attractive but increases modality/end-market concentration risk.
Reference market price used for this review: KRW 1.405m on 2026-09-11 from a secondary market-data source; not exchange-audited.

source_note: Primary filings and official company/target disclosures dominate. The market price is secondary and is used only as a reference quote. Facts, estimates and inferences are kept separate.
